description: Permanently delete one of the workspace's custom backgrounds, e.g. a scene the user no longer wants in their list. It cannot be undone through this server; a deleted scene has to be made again with create_background. Photos already generated with it are not affected, and no credits are charged or refunded. Only custom backgrounds (`custom: true` in list_backgrounds) can be deleted, never built-in ones. To change a scene instead of removing it, use refine_background. Returns the `id` with `deleted: true`, or `not_found` for an unknown id.
name: delete_background
title: Delete custom background
